notes.title: 🎮 Sealed In Demo Release Date Announcement! 🎮
notes.notes: [h1]I'm excited to announce that a demo version of Sealed In will be releasing on 16 September![/h1][p][/p][h2] This demo will give you a little sneak peek into what i've been building, including the UV flashlight mechanic, the hidden evidence pieces, and most important some mannequin "friendly" encounters.[/h2][h2] Your feedback is extremely important, so after you've tried the demo, let me know what do you think in the community hub. Together, we can make the full release something awesome![/h2][p][/p][h1]Mark your calendars: 16 September[/h1][h1]Wishlist the game to get notified as soon as the demo releases! [/h1]
